name: fleet_haiku_contrarian_turnarounds
strategy: Energy supercycle with tactical growth rotation and macro hedging, pivoting from defensive positioning as market cycle advances.
reassessment_note: Original defensive rotation thesis (macro cycle bottoming) less relevant given market rally (+1.71% SPY), weak performance of defensive sectors (XLV/XLU/XLP down 1-3%), and Fed stabilization post-rate hike. Energy complex structurally advantaged: crude +60% YoY, EIA forecasts $90/b for 2H26 with Middle East supply constraints persisting through Q2 2027. Growth showing recovery: AI operational progress (ADBE Firefly $650M+ ARR, CRM +20.67%) validates turnaround. Rotating from defensive holds to commodity supercycle exposure while maintaining crypto macro hedge and tactical short duration position. Addresses high opportunity cost of 68.5% cash allocation.

positions.thesis: Energy sector contrarian play: crude +60% YoY (+$59 from year-ago $40), currently $99.53. Structural tailwinds from Middle East supply constraints through Q2 2027 (400M barrel drawdown YTD, gradual Strait of Hormuz recovery). EIA 2H26 Brent forecast $90/b implies 10-15% upside. Differentiates portfolio from R2's tech/SaaS focus, captures commodity supercycle absent from prior book. Producer valuations compressed vs commodity prices.

Mega-cap AI infrastructure play diversified from R2's SaaS exposure. Benefits from cloud/enterprise AI buildout and AI compute demand. Valuation resilient (15x blended), portfolio diversifier. Reduces concentration in ADBE/CRM recovery thesis. Captures AI beneficiary without being pure SaaS disruption play like R2.

Increased crypto allocation (up from 6%) as macro hedge and momentum play. BTC up 26.59% from Aug 10 entry, $80,901 current vs $63,910 entry (R2). Fed rate cycle stabilizing at 4.00% after 25bp hike reduces headwind. Post-CLARITY Act failure, regulatory uncertainty creates asymmetric opportunity. Hold for macro diversification and bull cycle positioning.

Scaled up from 4.5% to 8%. ETH +39.55% from Aug 10 entry, $2,611 current vs $1,871 entry. Ethereum technical targets $2,920 if holding above $2,438; September average forecast $2,438.74. Provides tactical crypto exposure and macro hedge. Participation in AI/smart contract ecosystem potential.

Short duration proxy: tactically bearish bonds after 10-year yield spike above 5%. TLT (20+ yr bonds) highest duration risk if rates stabilize or rise further. Fed at 4.00%, markets pricing limited cuts or plateau. Bearish duration positioning creates convexity hedge and tactical short if bond yields stall. Respects novelty constraint (short position not in R2 which was all-long). Net portfolio remains 55% long despite short.
